subject: Lattice Labs + Redwood: TraceBridge SDK integration pilot
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@latticelabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Lattice Labs + Redwood: TraceBridge SDK integration pilot

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time last week. Lattice Labs' SDK + Redwood runtime feels like a natural fit: our customers want the kind of cross-runtime traceability your team explained and we think a small pilot could prove joint value quickly.

Proposed goals for the pilot (1 month):
- Ship a lightweight adapter so TraceBridge events are emitted from Lattice's LangChain/LlamaIndex plugins into Redwood Console.
- Validate telemetry fields for cost attribution and prompt-level latency.
- Run a small perf/regression test with a subset of Lattice's customer prompts.

Can your team commit an engineering point of contact and a rough availability window for a kickoff next week? I attached a very short mutual action plan we can iterate on.

I'll loop in Marissa and Grace on telemetry and onboarding. Looking forward —

Jonas
Director, Ecosystem Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: joint-action-plan-v1.docx (summary)
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@latticelabs.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@latticelabs.ai>
Date: 2027-03-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lattice Labs + Redwood: TraceBridge SDK integration pilot

Thanks Jonas — excited to move forward.

Quick answers: Priya (cc'd) will own delivery from our side; engineering lead is Miguel Torres (miguel.t@latticelabs.ai). We can do a kickoff the week of 3/21.

A couple of clarifying points before we lock dates:
- Our SDK currently emits a lightweight trace envelope tied to request_id and model_version; does Redwood Console accept custom trace schemas or do you want us to map to a canonical shape?
- We need to understand token-level cost attribution. Does Redwood provide token-level timestamps/offsets in the trace, or would we map to request-level metrics?
- Privacy: some customers deploy on-prem; we need a plan for private deployments where we can't send traces to hosted services.

We're happy to sign an NDA if needed and will pull our security questionnaire together after kickoff.

Alex
Head of Integrations, Lattice Labs

Subject: Re: Lattice Labs + Redwood: TraceBridge SDK integration pilot — telemetry + scope

Hi Alex / Priya —

Great to meet you both. Short answers and a technical proposal below.

1) Schema compatibility
We can accept custom trace envelopes, but to get the best UX in Redwood Console we'll want a small mapping layer on your side that emits the following fields (attached as sdk-telemetry-schema-v1.json): request_id, customer_id (hashed), model_name, model_version, prompt_token_count, response_token_count, token_timestamps (optional array), start_ts, end_ts, latency_ms, batching_key (if batched), cache_hit (boolean), and trace_id. If you emit token_timestamps we can show token-level waterfall charts; otherwise we'll backfill per-request aggregates.

2) Token-level cost attribution
We can accept token-level offsets for precise cost reconciliation. If token-level isn't feasible in the pilot, request-level token counts + model_version are sufficient to estimate costs. We will share a small script to reconcile billing metrics.

3) Private/on-prem deployments
For private deployments we support a pull-based collection: your connector can write traces to a S3/GCS bucket or push to a private endpoint we provision in the customer's VPC. We'll coordinate with your ops lead on network auth; we'll bring Aditya for the initial network design.

Suggested pilot milestones (I added timing in DAYS):
- Day 0 (kickoff): align on schema, test account + creds; set success metrics.
- Day 3: minimal adapter prototype that emits mapped traces to a Redwood test tenant.
- Day 10: instrument 3 canonical prompts, run perf + correctness checks.
- Day 20: joint demo with a Lattice customer (opt-in).

I've attached sdk-telemetry-schema-v1.json and a short MAP doc. Can you confirm Miguel as the eng owner and whether you need an NDA?

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Product Manager, Ecosystem Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sdk-telemetry-schema-v1.json
From: Priya Sharma <priya@latticelabs.ai>

Date: 2027-03-16T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lattice Labs + Redwood: TraceBridge SDK integration pilot — security questions

Hi all —

Thanks for the clear plan, Marissa. We prepped a short security questionnaire and attached a redacted copy (latticelabs-security-questionnaire.pdf). High level: our customers ask about data retention and PII handling during traces. A few specifics:
- Is Redwood able to mask or drop raw prompt text from traces (store only token counts + hashes) for compliance customers?
- For hosted mode what is the retention window for traces and can that be shortened per-customer?
- If we ship a connector to write traces to S3 in a private deployment, do you require any particular KMS?

We'll run this by our security team but wanted to get these on the table ahead of kickoff. Also confirming Miguel (miguel.t@latticelabs.ai) as eng owner — he'll join the kickoff.

Thanks,
Priya
Head of Platform Partnerships
Lattice Labs

Attachment: latticelabs-security-questionnaire.pdf

Subject: Re: Lattice Labs + Redwood: TraceBridge SDK integration pilot — kickoff details and MAP

Alex / Priya —

Thanks everyone. Quick updates:
- Miguel confirmed for kickoff (3/22, 10am PT) — invite sent.
- NDA: legal sent a mutual NDA; Alex confirmed acceptance yesterday.
- Security q's: short answers here so we have context for the call:
  * Masking: yes — Redwood supports configurable redaction rules (hashing or dropping). We'll bring our privacy engineer if the customer needs guaranteed non-storage of plaintext.
  * Retention: hosted traces default 90 days; per-customer retention windows down to 7 days possible under Dedicated/Private agreements.
  * KMS: we accept AWS KMS or customer-managed keys; we'll document required key policies.

Attached is an updated joint-action-plan-v1.docx with explicit owners. Action items before kickoff:
- Lattice: share SDK repo access and an example LangChain plugin (Miguel).
- Redwood: provide test tenant + API keys and the telemetry mapping script (Marissa).
- Both: review security questionnaire (Priya / Aditya).

Link to MAP: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C-joint-action-plan (same as attachment). Please review and comment by 3/19 EOD so the kickoff can be productive.

Looking forward —
Jonas
Director, Ecosystem Partnerships
